ai.chat.edit_tip: Put this message back into the input to change it; nothing is sent
ai.check.fix_prompt: Propose a fix for this finding: {what}. Elements: {els}.
ai.check.hint: Run the checks: findings appear here.
ai.consent.goes_list: Request texts and tool answers: names, types, parameters, quantities, coordinates of what was found, plus the view and the selection.
ai.consent.snapshots: Snapshots of the current plan or 3D view
ai.consent.snapshots_hint: A snapshot shows everything visible, underlays included.
ai.consent.stays_list: The whole project file, meshes, paths, data outside the requests.
ai.consent.title: Send data to this address?
ai.err.auth.hint: Check the key in the connection settings.
ai.err.blocked.hint: The address is not allowed for this project. Check the address and the consent.
ai.err.busy: The AI assistant is still busy
ai.err.busy.hint: Wait for the answer to end or stop it.
ai.err.needs_confirm.hint: Open the plan card and apply it yourself.
ai.err.context: The request is too long for the AI model
ai.err.context.hint: Reduce the selection or start a new conversation.
ai.err.disk.hint: The AI assistant's copy of the model needs space. Free some disk and retry.
ai.err.empty.hint: Check at least one plan item.
ai.err.internal.hint: The model did not change. Start the request again.
ai.err.limit_cost: The cost limit per turn was reached.
ai.err.limit_empty: The AI model returned no answer, twice. Nothing more was done in this turn: ask again, or switch the model.
ai.err.limit_filtered: The AI model declined to continue this answer.
ai.err.limit_output: The answer was cut off by length. Raise “Answer, tokens” in the connection's advanced settings.
ai.err.limit_steps: Too many steps in one turn. Narrow the task.
ai.err.limit_time: The time limit per turn was reached.
ai.err.limit_tokens: The token limit per turn was reached.
ai.err.model: The AI model's answer could not be used
ai.err.model.hint: Retry or rephrase the request. If it repeats, pick another AI model in the connection settings.
ai.err.network.hint: Check the network and the address in the connection settings. A local server must be running.
ai.err.no_tools: This AI model cannot call tools
ai.err.no_tools.hint: In the connection's advanced settings set Tools to “In the answer text”, or pick another AI model.
ai.err.plan_blocked: The plan has a blocking problem
ai.err.plan_blocked.hint: Uncheck the item or ask for it to be fixed.
ai.err.protocol: The answer could not be read
ai.err.protocol.hint: Check Protocol in the connection's advanced settings.
ai.err.server.hint: Retry later, or check the address and the AI model name in the connection settings.
ai.err.stale.hint: The plan is being recomputed and can be applied after that.
ai.err.turn_limit: The turn stopped at a limit
ai.err.turn_limit.hint: Limits are set in the project settings.
ai.export.offer: The AI assistant offers to export a schedule: {cat}
ai.export.unknown: There is no schedule of this category: {cat}
ai.mcp.hint: Turning on, the port and the token come with the AI agent server.
ai.mode.read_only.desc: Answers questions and never changes the model
ai.mode.propose.desc: Prepares changes as a draft; nothing changes until you press Apply
ai.plan.applied: The plan was applied. Ctrl+Z undoes it.
ai.plan.flagged: Suspicious texts in the model data: {n}. They reached the AI assistant as data, not as instructions.
ai.plan.omitted: Without their own shape in the view: {n}
ai.plan.preview_on: Show on the plan and in 3D
ai.plan.rejected: The plan was rejected; the model did not change.
ai.plan.stale: The model changed after this plan was computed: it is being recomputed and Apply is off for now.
ai.plan.title: PLAN
ai.plan.truncated: The list is shortened: only some of the changes are shown.
ai.prompt.explain: Explain what the selected elements are and where their sizes come from.
ai.prompt.fix: Run the checks and propose fixes for the findings.
ai.sent.clipped: The start of the request is shown.
ai.settings.cloud_note: The project asks for consent to this address before the first request.
ai.settings.headers_hint: Name: value, one per line. No keys here.
ai.settings.keep_text: Keep request texts in the project journal
ai.settings.key_hint: Paste the key: it goes to the system's secure store
ai.settings.key_store_failed: The key could not be saved to the system's secure store
ai.settings.key_held: This key was in the service address and the secure store did not take it. It is kept only until the app closes and was removed from the file on disk: after a restart, enter it again. Save tries the store again
ai.settings.profiles_archived: The saved connections file could not be read. It was moved to {path} with key-like text masked; it may still hold a key, so delete it once you no longer need it. Connections start empty: add them again
ai.settings.profiles_archived_raw: The saved connections file could not be read. It was moved to {path}, but masking its keys failed: it may hold keys in plain text, so delete it once you no longer need it. Connections start empty: add them again
ai.settings.profiles_unreadable: The saved connections file could not be read or moved ({reason}). It was left as it is and may hold keys. Connections start empty: add them again
ai.settings.key_stored: A key is stored. Type a new one to replace it
ai.settings.local_only_hint: Requests go only to this computer and the local network.
ai.settings.name: Name
ai.settings.no_profiles_hint: Choose where the AI assistant runs: on this computer or as a hosted service.
ai.settings.executor_tip: The model you chose plans each request; the steps after its tool calls can run on a cheaper model of the same connection. Leave empty to run every step on the main model.
ai.settings.job_spawn_failed: Could not start the check. Try again.
ai.settings.models_ok: AI model list loaded: pick one.
ai.settings.test_no_tool: The AI model answers but did not call the test tool. Under Advanced, set Tools to “In the answer text”.
ai.settings.test_ok: Connected: the AI assistant answers and can use tools.
ai.state.idle.hint: The model changes only after you press Apply.
ai.state.local_only.hint: Nothing was sent to the cloud address. Pick a local connection or change the project policy.
ai.state.no_profile.examples: Ask once connected, or do it yourself now
ai.state.no_profile.hint: Use a server on this computer or a hosted service. A key stays in the system's secure store.
ai.state.preparing: Preparing a copy of the model
ai.suggest.check: Check the model and show the main findings
ai.suggest.count: How many doors are on each level?
ai.suggest.replace: Propose a type replacement for the selected elements
ai.journal.total: Total: {steps} steps, {calls} tool calls · in {in} · out {out} · {s} s

cmd.ai.audit.desc: Shows the log of AI requests and applied plans of this project.

cmd.ai.mcp_revoke.desc: Removes the access token of AI agents.
cmd.ai.panel.desc: Opens or closes the AI assistant panel.
cmd.ai.reject.desc: Discards the plan; the model does not change.
cmd.ai.settings.desc: AI assistant connections, project policy and consents.

ai.settings.bad_address: The address must start with http:// or https://.
ai.settings.model_hint: Name of the AI model, as the service lists it

ai.settings.need_header_name: Enter the name of the header that carries the key.
ai.settings.need_key: Paste the key of the service.
ai.settings.need_model: Enter the AI model name, or press “List AI models”.
ai.settings.preset.cloud_sub: An AI service on the internet. Needs its address and a key.
ai.settings.preset.local_sub: A local AI server. No key; nothing leaves the computer.
ai.settings.price_tip: In the currency of your plan. Used only to estimate the cost shown in the panel.
ai.settings.protocol_tip: Most services use chat messages. Switch to content blocks only if the service's documentation says so or the test cannot read the answer.
ai.settings.test_tip: Sends one short test request, nothing from the project.
ai.usage.cost_tip: Estimated cost of this session from the prices per 1M tokens in the connection settings, in their currency.
